analysis: Both changed files are documentation only; no executable code, workflow or configuration changed, so no direct security regression is visible. docs/reference/model-registry-format.md: the date bump, plus a new sentence at head lines 119-122 saying macOS drops file pages from the cache after each hashing read (PageCache.swift). This describes a memory-residency behavior and does not change the aggregate-hash verification contract. The rest of head lines 388-466 is the base text shifted by 3 lines, with no content change in the authentication table (publishing key, bootstrap key, admin key) or the publish tooling. docs/reference/protocol-messages.md (patch only): documents GLM5Next request-control behavior. Null reasoning members are treated as unset. reasoning.summary and reasoning.generate_summary accept auto, concise or detailed as no-ops. Top-level thinking can be an object, with clear_thinking inside it. Tool and history reasoning rendering is described. JSON response_format is served by post-validation, not constrained decoding, and failures return 422 tool_noncompliance with no content exposed. tool_choice required or named function is served by structured post-validation. These claims are about provider Swift code that is not supplied (GLM5NextPromptPolicy.swift, ToolConstraintValidation, GLM5NextResponseFormat), so the documented fail-closed behavior is unverified. Relevant to T-008 and T-052 only if the code diverges from the docs. The patch excerpt is marked incomplete (truncated), so later table rows are not fully seen. Next pass: if the corresponding code ships in the same PR, check that the parsing of the newly accepted controls (null handling, thinking object, forced tool choice) rejects unknown members and exposes no withheld or invalid output, and that the new advertised tool-constraint protocol v1 routing cannot send requests to providers lacking enforcement. No threat-model update is needed for the documentation text alone.
